ratings.reason: Authoring and assessing principle sets for deployed chatbots is central and strongly matches user-authored standing policy. The evidence names the collection and authoring activity but does not expose add/edit/remove/reorder behavior, persistence, or compilation details.

ratings.reason: Users add custom requirements to visible pedagogical constraints that the AI follows during script generation, so authoring and consultation are clear. ratings.reason: Interactive refinement of evaluation criteria is a clear mechanism, but it concerns judging outputs rather than maintaining a standing policy consulted during generation.
